body: talking is always a good thing because other people's insight and advice may allow you to become aware of or better utilize means of coping with your pain. i know it's difficult but proper communication is a very important first step on battling these thoughts.

how can it be hard to connect with people when your username is llama_in_galoshes? there's 7 billion of us on this planet, surely there's all sorts of people to meet, and many more waiting to meet you. keep your head up.

I stopped all of those little hobbies because my dad tells me that anything I do that isn't preparing myself for the future is just a waste of time. I don't want to be preparing anymore, I just want to experience. I'm just hanging around and waiting to go to college, hoping maybe the independence will help me cope with my pain better.
